definitions.title: Continuous Mixture Tank Model
definitions.statement: The rate of change of solute mass y(t) in a well-stirred tank equals the incoming mass flux minus the outgoing mass flux.
definitions.explanation: Yields a standard first-order linear differential equation.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Rate of change = Input rate - Output rate.

definitions.title: Orthogonal Trajectories
definitions.statement: A family of curves that intersects every member of another given family of curves at right angles (90 degrees).
conditions: Slopes are negative reciprocals at all intersection points
definitions.explanation: Models electric field lines and equipotential curves, or fluid streamlines and velocity potentials.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Replace dy/dx with -dx/dy to find orthogonal trajectories.
